Context: NarrationSafetyValidator._validate_segments rejects narration with "narration mentions an unavailable entity '<form>'" (code narration_known_term_leak) when an entity alias is not in allowed_entities | earned_entity_ids and not covered by a grounding statement or handoff text. Two false rejections in story continuity-initiative must be fixed with two STORY-NEUTRAL engine changes. No story names, ids or words may appear in the code.

Change 1 (owned places). A location is nameable in a scene when its world `owner` (storygame/story_package/models.py Location.owner) is one of that scene's participant_ids, and so is every location inside it (walk `parent` downward, like _related_area_ids does). Add this in NarrationSafetyValidator._scene_entity_ids. Real case: world.yaml executive_office has owner rebecca and broadcast_chamber has parent executive_office; scene 3A lists rebecca in participant_ids, so 3A narration may say 'broadcast chamber'. Scenes 1A-2C do not list rebecca, so they must still reject 'broadcast chamber'.

Change 2 (names the scene's own text uses). In _validate_segments' entity loop, also skip a form when the current scene's own authored text says that place name. The text to search is the scene's scene_frames 'situation' line (find where the package stores scene_frames; knowledge.yaml has them) plus the existing self._projected_beat_text(state). Match the form allowing an optional plural 's' on its last word, so form 'detention level' is found in 'tied to the detention levels'. Apply this only for entities that are locations (world.locations), never items or people. Real case: scene 2B's situation says 'a medical terminal tied to the detention levels', so 2B narration may say 'detention level'. Scene 1A, whose text never says it, must still reject it.

Tests in tests/test_narration_place_names.py, on the real continuity-initiative package (copy how tests/test_narration_fixed_thing_terms.py loads the package and drives the validator): (1) 3A accepts narration containing 'broadcast chamber'; (2) 1B still rejects it; (3) 2B accepts 'detention level'; (4) 1A still rejects 'detention level'. Make each test fail without the corresponding change.
